chapter: Jess Stacy, Goodman and New York characters
title: Jess Stacy and Benny Goodman coming to hear Hodes
summary: DeMichael asks about Jess Stacy trying to get Hodes into Goodman's band. Hodes tells of working in Chicago with Rod Cless when Goodman came with John Hammond.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Just to go off on a tangent here, you mentioned earlier that Jess Stacy was always helping you to get jobs back in the old days in Chicago.
You mentioned clarinet players and piano players and so forth. And Jess, you said, tried to get you into Benny Goodman's band when he was leaving.

I followed Jess through numerous jobs. He's been very kind to me. And then one day I got a call that Benny Goodman was coming down to work, I was playing, I was playing with Rod Cless, someplace in Chicago, 5100 Club or something, 5100 North Broadway. And Baby Frank Snyder was playing drums.

Everybody got very excited, and I said, what's all the excitement about? Benny Goodman. So, who's Benny Goodman? He's got a big band. I wasn't interested. I was interested in small bands, even then. He came with John Hammond and he came with this girl singer and I think at that time it was Helen Forrest.
